name: Setzer, Wandering Gambler
oracle_text:
When Setzer enters, create The Blackjack, a legendary 3/3 colorless Vehicle artifact token with flying and crew 2.
Whenever a Vehicle you control deals combat damage to a player, flip a coin.
Whenever you win a coin flip, create two tapped Treasure tokens.
blocked_sentences: Whenever you win a coin flip, create two tapped Treasure tokens.

needs.what: a trigger event that fires whenever a player wins a coin flip, filterable by who flipped ("whenever you win a coin flip"), fired from the flip_coin op whenever its result is a win -- including flips caused by other cards' effects, not only this card's own
needs.why_existing_wont_do: trigger_events has no coin-flip event; the engine emits EventType.COIN_FLIPPED (carrying `won`) from the flip_coin op only for the log, and no trigger can listen to it. Putting the Treasure creation in the second ability's flip_coin win branch would miss every coin flip won from any other source, a narrower card
